LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_BroodMatrix_Des: A brood organ with four capsules that grow children up to thirteen eighty times faster on hemogel. A living outsider sealed in its core ages away while its skills, passions, traits and genes are shared among the children. Pawns accepted by the flesh colony or grown in the flesh can never be donors.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixInsertOccupantDesc: Choose a baby or child younger than {0} for a free capsule. Babies, prisoners and downed captives are carried in by haulers; your own children walk in. Growth runs eighty times faster but only while a donor sits in the core, and the child leaves at {0} marked as flesh-grown.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixInsertDonorDesc: Choose an adult outsider: a prisoner, slave, or downed enemy. Pawns accepted by the flesh colony or grown in flesh are unsuitable.\n\nThe donor's remaining lifetime is spent only while children grow. Raising one child to age thirteen requires two donors. Skills, passions, traits, and genes pass to the children; the donor dies when their remaining lifetime is exhausted.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixDonorWarning: Seal donor {0} inside the brood matrix core? Their inheritance will pass to the children while they age rapidly, and they will die once their remaining lifetime is exhausted.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixCancelLoadDesc: Cancel every pending child and donor assignment.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixEjectOccupantDesc: Release a child from its capsule early. What it has already inherited stays with it.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixExtractDonorDesc: Release the donor alive. Aging and inheritance already passed to the children are not reversed.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixAutoLoadDesc: When a capsule is free, automatically assign babies of your colony on this map to it.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixNoFreeCapsule: All capsules are occupied or reserved.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectNotAssigned: Not assigned to this brood matrix.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectNotHumanlike: Only humanlike flesh can be used.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectMustBeDowned: An outsider must be downed or imprisoned first.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectTooOld: Only babies and children younger than {0} fit in a capsule.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectDonorPresent: The core already holds a donor.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectFleshColony: Members of the flesh colony, pawns accepted by it and the flesh-grown cannot be donors.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixRejectLifespanSpent: Too old: its lifespan is already spent.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixInheritanceInspect: Inheritance left: skill levels {0}, passions {1}, traits {2}, genes {3}
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixNoDonorInspect: No donor: the children do not grow and nothing is inherited.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixSupplyInspect: Food reserve: {0} of {1} h; capsules and donor consume +{2}/h
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixOccupantGrownMessage: {0} has grown up in the brood matrix and left its capsule.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixOccupantStarvedMessage: {0} died of bio-starvation in the brood matrix.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixDonorSpentLetterText: Donor {0} has reached the end of their life inside the brood matrix. Their remaining inheritance has been passed to the children, and the organ has absorbed their body.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixInheritanceHint: Unticked parts of the inheritance stay with the donor: they neither flow into the children nor leave the donor. Tick them again and everything held back flows in at once; if the donor dies first, it is lost.
